translations.web: They kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the “rising from the dead” meant.
translations.bsb: So they kept this matter to themselves, discussing what it meant to rise from the dead.
translations.kjv: And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.
translations.asv: And they kept the saying, questioning among themselves what the rising again from the dead should mean.
